title: Rooks behind passed pawns
line: Behind your own passed pawn, and behind the enemy's.

steps.text: A rook usually belongs behind a passed pawn. From there it guards the pawn, and it gains room each time the pawn steps up.
Black's rook attacks your passed pawn. Guard it from behind.
steps.hint: Bring the rook to the pawn's file, below it.
steps.after: Guarded from behind, the pawn is safe, and the rook pushes it on when the time comes.

steps.text: In front of its pawn, a rook is stuck: if it leaves the pawn's file, Black's rook takes the pawn. The black king just waits on g7 and h7.
Now you have Black. Put your rook behind White's passed pawn.
steps.hint: The pawn's file, below the pawn.
steps.after: From behind, the rook holds the pawn back, and it gets stronger as the pawn moves up.

summary: Put rooks behind passed pawns: behind your own to push it, behind the enemy's to hold it back.
